summary: Dedicated security professional with over 8 years of experience protecting commercial and industrial premises. Skilled in access control, patrol procedures, emergency response, and detailed incident reporting, with a commitment to maintaining safe and secure environments.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees and visitors, checking identification and issuing temporary badges.
Patrol commercial premises on foot and via vehicle to detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.
Respond to alarms and investigate disturbances, coordinating with law enforcement when necessary.
Write detailed daily reports of activities and irregularities, such as equipment damage, theft, or unusual occurrences.

experience.title: Security Officer
bullets: Locked and unlocked doors and gates of entrances and exits to secure buildings according to schedule.
Circulated among visitors and employees to preserve order and protect property, de-escalating conflicts as needed.
Administered basic first aid and obtained paramedic assistance during medical emergencies.
Warned persons of rule infractions and evicted violators from premises, using force only when necessary.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Answered alarms and investigated disturbances, documenting findings in shift logs.
Monitored and authorized entrance and departure of personnel and visitors to guard against theft.
Conducted regular patrols of industrial premises, reporting security hazards and maintenance issues.
Wrote reports of daily activities and irregularities, including unauthorized persons and property damage.
